title: KAITO — Idol Fan In SEKAI〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hi, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You seem to be in a cheerful mood♪
Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Something good... More specifically, I'd say it was something fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I actually just had a chance to take a peek at what was going on with the grand prix.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I was wondering where you'd gone. You went to take another look?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The grand prix's been all you can think about since it started, huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Of course!
It's a hugely important event for idol fans.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Plus, Minori and the others were doing their best again today by doing another stream for their channel.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They showed everybody what the Lumina Forum has to offer, and their fans seemed very excited.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They even managed to attract a lot of new viewers. I think it's because of the talk show from the other day!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The one for Lumina Time, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Minori did a wonderful job of expressing herself, but so did the others. It ended up being a very good show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, the other idols also have really strong beliefs.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I actually started tearing up a little when I saw Minori trying so hard to explain her own...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you didn't just tear up, Rin. You bawled your eyes out, if I recall.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was so delighted when they began to understand each other's beliefs.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Getting to see idols exchange their thoughts in such a way may be a unique feature of this program.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Idols are charming in many ways. Some are cute, some are cool and they know how to put on fun shows...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that moment reminded me of why they're able to excite me so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, me too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Plus, we got to see the girls establish fun rivalries with some really great idols.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now I really can't take my eyes off of this grand prix.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what the next Lumina Time involves! What do you think they're going to have everyone do?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... It's a show about idols, so something involving singing and dancing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Every group is going to have different strengths, so they'll want to take advantage of any Lumina Time that covers their areas of expertise.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For live performances, I feel that everybody's attention is going to be focused on ReLight.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't forget about Cheerful * Days.
They were so amazing in that video I saw of them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For variety stuff, I bet Hikarin would steal the show! The way she talks is gonna allow her to suck more people into her universe♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe. I also wanna see that.
But we can't rule out some other idol stealing the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Good point...!
A lot of them still probably haven't shown their full power yet...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Our girls are more than ready for them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course they are.
We know that better than anyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That means, to make sure they get to shine like crazy, we gotta give them all the support we can!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What makes you say that all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, you all seem to have a better understanding of why this grand prix has me so excited.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're starting to show interest in what the other groups can do, and making predictions about what's going to happen moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's true.
I have a better understanding of where all your enthusiasm is coming from, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Please let me know the next time you're thinking about going over to see them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! I don't wanna miss out on anything good♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sure. We can watch over them together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I honestly can't wait to see what this grand prix has in store for us...!
